title: Do You Copy? The dialog system in Firewatch
read_scope: Complete extracted text of 77 physical PDF pages, including speaker notes; session identity page. No diagram pixels, presentation video or audio reviewed.

claims.scope: Authors describe interrupted Julia conversations leaving character knowledge ahead of information conveyed to the player; not evidence of precise fact-write timing.
Authors report start/stop events with reference counting for normal player control, and discuss fragility of non-linear conversational state. No reconstruction of unseen diagram arrows.
Conversation container and automatic state entry/exit are explicitly further-work proposals, not a demonstrated shipped repair.

editorial_boundary: The camp branch is an original paper example. Do not merge story-information progress and control restriction ownership; no complete state/lock implementation or runtime verification.
retrieval_limit: Ordinary local PDF retrieval returned HTTP403 and was not bypassed; browser extracted source text remained readable. Screenshot requests supplied no viewable pixels.
